newsitem.title: INDIA: India budget session to begin February 20.
newsitem.headline: India budget session to begin February 20.

text.p: The Indian parliament will meet sometime around February 20 to begin discussions on the budget for the financial year 1997/98, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported on Saturday.
A final decision is to be taken next week on the schedule for the session in which Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's United Front coalition will present its second budget, PTI said.
The general budget is to be presented on February 28, while the railway budget will be presented four days earlier, on February 24, PTI said, quoting official sources.
The pre-budget economic survey will probably be tabled a couple of days ahead of the budget, it added.
The budget session will open with an address to both houses of parliament by President Shankar Dayal Sharma.
